meta.description: Anna University, Chennai — Tamil Nadu's premier technical university.

description: Tamil Nadu's leading technical university with 4 constituent colleges and 500+ affiliated colleges. Offers B.E., B.Tech, M.E., M.Tech, MBA, MCA, M.Sc., and Ph.D. programs. Follows CBCS with 10-point UGC grading (O/A+/A/B+/B/C/P/F). Semester system.

academic_calendar.details: Odd semester: Jun-Nov, Even semester: Dec-May. End semester exams in Nov and May respectively.

available.description: Choice Based Credit System with 5 units, 100 marks per subject (50 ESE + 50 CIA)

available.description: Curriculum 2021 with 5 units, outcome-based education, enhanced continuous assessment
